name: @pipeworx/mcp-barcelona-events

tools.name: events
tools.description: Find upcoming cultural events & activities in Barcelona, Spain. Filter by keyword, district (e.g. "Eixample", "Ciutat Vella", "Gràcia") and date window. Returns events with venue, district, coordinates and dates. Content is in Catalan/Spanish.

query.description: Keyword over title and description, e.g. "música", "exposició", "infantil".

district.description: Filter by district, e.g. "Eixample", "Ciutat Vella", "Gràcia", "Sant Martí".

from.description: Include events ending on/after this date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

to.description: Include events starting on/before this date YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-barcelona-events forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the barcelona-events pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
